results.finding: Standalone component story — no 5-zone layout architecture (功能区/侧栏/编辑区) to evaluate information density gradient.
Standalone component story — no primary/secondary surface hierarchy to evaluate. No editing surface (编辑区) present.
Standalone component story — no 260px sidebar or flex:1 editing area layout architecture.

Component rendered at all 3 viewports (desktop: 7 stories, tablet: 7, mobile: 7) without errors. Component does not use responsive breakpoint classes — expected for a focused UI element rather than a page layout.
No horizontal overflow detected at any viewport. All content fits within viewport width.
Component has no interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) requiring touch targets.
Body element applies env(safe-area-inset-top) and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) via globals.css. Safe area padding is present.

Component uses Tailwind spacing classes (p-2.5, p-3, gap-1.5, etc.) instead of CSS custom property tokens (--space-*). While Tailwind classes follow a consistent 4px scale, the project defines semantic spacing tokens (--space-gutter:16px, --space-stack:12px, etc.) that are not directly referenced. Potential magic px values: marginRight=1.11514px.
MarkdownRenderer uses overflow-x-auto on <pre> blocks for code overflow, prose-sm for text wrapping, and has an ErrorBoundary fallback. Long Content story confirms truncation behavior.
Component does not use flex layout with truncatable children.

MarkdownRenderer returns null for empty content string (handled at line 97-99). ErrorBoundary catches render errors and displays fallback content. Empty story in Storybook confirms graceful empty handling.

KaTeX formulas render via rehype-katex with proper CSS. The .katex element uses color: var(--text-primary) and font-size: text-base via globals.css. Long math expressions in display mode ($$...$$) will scroll naturally within their container. No formula truncation damage expected.

Project uses consistent responsive breakpoints defined in @theme: sm=640px, md=768px, lg=1024px, xl=1280px. This component does not use responsive classes, which is appropriate for its role as a focused UI element.
Component is a single-column UI element. No multi-column layout that requires stacking at mobile viewport.
Component does not use responsive visibility toggles (hidden/sm:block or similar patterns).
Body font-size on mobile viewport: 16px (≥16px). No iOS auto-zoom risk.
